summary.title: Immediate AI food analysis and refine option
changes: Trio starts an immediate AI analysis when you take or select a food photo and shows provisional nutrient estimates.
You can add a description and tap Continue to send a refinement that updates the analysis before confirming.
Provisional estimates appear below the description and are not applied to treatments until you confirm.
The description area shows statuses like "Analyzing image…" and a preliminary total while streaming updates arrive.
You can cancel the preview analysis to stop background work without changing the treatment form.
